title: Documentary narrator vs a hornbill on a log

scenes.headline: Ground hornbills hunt on foot, up to 11 km a day
scenes.body: They are mostly carnivorous and roost in trees at night. This one lives in a zoo and is clearly off duty.

caption:
Breathtaking. Truly breathtaking.

Northern ground hornbills are long-lived: in captivity they have reached about 40 years.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Bucorvus abyssinicus).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Spoofs the hushed, epic documentary-narrator voice (no real narrator named or imitated by name) over a deliberately uneventful zoo clip, then pays off with the bird's real walking range.
